title: Normal monogenic covers: etale normality, inertia, purity and finite-cover comparison

sources.role: Proposition 41.19.7: normality is preserved by an etale local ring map. Used after etale Keller base change of a normal monogenic cover.

Section 58.13, inertia definition, Lemmas 58.13.1-2, Example 58.13.3 and Lemma 58.13.4: inertia kernels describe the unramified quotient; for a regular base codimension-one inertia suffices by purity.
Lemma 58.21.4: a quasi-finite normal cover of a regular base, unramified in codimension one, is etale. Applied only to a finite normal quotient cover over complex affine space.

Retained version 2.21, printed page 28, paragraph before Theorem 3.4: finite etale complex covers give finite topological coverings. Only this forward direction is used; contractibility of C^n then excludes a connected cover of degree greater than one.
